title: N11 fold is skin-deep: the gallery retries field is dead code — GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES does not exist and the stage machine still retries forever
evidence: app/gallery.odin:57: `retries:  int, // N11: the condition-poll frame budget (GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES)` — grep -n 'retries\|GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES' app/gallery.odin matches ONLY line 57 (the field is never read, incremented, or checked anywhere). gallery_frame still re-arms without any budget: `case .Noc:  if !app.overlay_on || !app.stats_valid { fmt.printfln("gallery: noc wait — overlay_on=%v stats_valid=%v mode=%v tick=%d terminal=%v", ...); gallery.wait = 5; return false }` — identical unbounded re-arm at .Draw_Release (`gallery.wait = 5 // the commit lands via the executor — poll`), .Deselect (`gallery.wait = 5 // the ESC deselect lands via the intent chain`), .Settings (`gallery.wait = 5`). Commit b4154c3 subject claims: 'fix: Perkins r1 — B1 fail-loud loader (report, never coerce), B2 PR body rewrite, + W1-W5, N1-N15'.
detail: The fix commit claims N11 folded, but only a dead field and a comment naming a never-defined constant were added. The unbounded capture hang N11 flagged is fully unchanged.
recommended_fix: Implement the budget: increment gallery.retries on each condition-poll re-arm, abort with the stage name at a cap (define GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES), reset on stage advance; or delete the dead field and correct the folded-claim.

title: Audio-seam refactor dropped rl.CloseAudioDevice() from audio_destroy — a behavior change in a refactor ruled in as behavior-preserving
detail: The seam refactor must preserve behavior exactly; instead the device-close teardown idiom was silently deleted in normal (non-SW) builds, and audio_destroy's doc comment ('close the device') is now false. Impact bounded: teardown runs only at process exit.
recommended_fix: Add an 18th wrapper pair `audio_close_device :: proc() { rl.CloseAudioDevice() }` / no-op, and call it at the end of audio_destroy (unconditionally, as before).

title: N10 not folded despite the claim: PP_SW_AUDIO still has no in-repo producer, and the seam's comment points at documentation that does not exist
evidence: app/audio/audio.odin:46: `// producer is the gallery build documented in app/gallery.odin.` — app/gallery.odin contains no build command (only `// NOTE: the gallery runs under the raylib-sw SOFTWARE renderer (the shadow build)`). grep -rn PP_SW_AUDIO across the repo matches only app/audio/audio.odin:39,47,257. tools/build_raylib_sw.sh ends: `echo "== done. Build the harness with:"` / `echo "   ODIN_ROOT=$SHADOW odin build harness -out:bin/harness"` — harness only, no app SW build line with -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true.
detail: The SW gallery app build remains irreproducible from the repo (r1 N10, claimed folded in b4154c3's 'N1-N15'). The new comment asserts a documentation location that was never written, compounding the gap.
recommended_fix: Add the app SW build line (ODIN_ROOT=... odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true) to build_raylib_sw.sh or a gallery doc block in app/gallery.odin.

title: N9 carries forward unchanged: gallery state is still a package-level mutable global (debug-only) with the carve-out still undocumented
evidence: app/gallery.odin:64: `gallery: Gallery` — file-scope mutable global inside the PP_DEBUG when-block (whole file compile-gated). project-context.md still states 'No globals / singletons. Everything hangs off App → Run_State' with no documented debug carve-out; the ODN-13 CI rule covers core/ only.
detail: r1 N9 (claimed folded in b4154c3's 'N1-N15') is verifiably unchanged: the state was not hung on App and the carve-out was not documented.
recommended_fix: Hang Gallery on App as a PP_DEBUG-gated field, or add one line to project-context.md documenting the debug-only global carve-out.

title: N2 partially folded: harness/font_check.odin still carries comments this PR itself made false — the rune-truncation claim, the deleted load_hud_font, and the pre-08-23 specimen sizes
detail: The r1 N2 fold updated crisis.odin and goldens.odin but left font_check.odin's header/specimen comments teaching the pre-overhaul behavior on the exact file this PR rewrote.
recommended_fix: Update the three comment blocks: UTF-8-safe draw helper, the load_fonts recipe, and the shipped 24/32/16/15 ladder.

title: B1 fold leaves one silent path: an unreadable FALLBACK font asset returns ok — the app runs with the ⚠ silently absent (CI pin only)
detail: A missing main asset refuses loudly (pinned); a missing fallback asset degrades silently at runtime — only the @(test) font_warning_glyph_in_merged_atlas catches it, in CI.
recommended_fix: Treat an unreadable fallback_path as failure (return nil, 0) when the main font had missing codepoints, matching the loader's fail-loud doctrine.

title: W1 fold left identical when/else EndDrawing scaffolding — both branches are the same call
detail: The conditional is pure noise: debug and release compile the same call. Behavior is correct (captures now post-flush in both modes), but the dead branch misleads readers into expecting a difference.
recommended_fix: Collapse to a single rl.EndDrawing() call with the flush-ordering comment; delete the empty when/else.
